currentFocus: S320 promoted the static content lane to production after 13.8 days: 259 content-pure paths, including the homepage Desk module, are live (contentLaneHead 60ed3748c). deploy-currency moved from a hard FAIL to content-current and doctor blocking failures went 1 to 0. nextMilestone: Confirm sign-in recovers at the 00:00 UTC reset, watch the first reader-engagement history rows accrue now that telemetry ingest is verified, and give the route-provenance probe a vantage CI can use so content promotion no longer depends on a locally run probe.
